components.name: Theme toggle
components.description: Circular control showing the available destination theme.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme" aria-label="Switch to dark theme"><svg width="21" height="21" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20.5 13.1A8.6 8.6 0 0 1 10.9 3.5a8.6 8.6 0 1 0 9.6 9.6Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text); background:transparent; border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s,border-color .15s; } .ds-theme:hover { background:var(--surface); border-color:var(--text-secondary); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Section navigation
components.description: Small sans serif links to the three primary sections.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1.8rem; font-family:var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav a { color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:.84rem; padding-block:.7rem; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--accent); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Writing row
components.description: Whole-row article link with a date column and serif title.
components.html:
Feb 15, 2026

Loneliness, optimized

On loneliness, forced optimism, and what the feed does with other people’s pain.
components.css: .ds-writing { display:grid; grid-template-columns:108px minmax(0,1fr); gap:1.2rem; padding:1.6rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; } .ds-writing time { font:.69rem/1.5 var(--font-mono); color:var(--text-secondary); padding-top:.5rem; } .ds-writing h3 { font:400 1.65rem/1.2 var(--font-display); letter-spacing:-.02em; margin:0 0 .4rem; } .ds-writing p { margin:0; font:.87rem/1.65 var(--font-sans); color:var(--text-secondary); } .ds-writing:hover h3 { color:var(--accent); } .ds-writing:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; } @media(max-width:650px) { .ds-writing { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:.45rem; } .ds-writing time { padding:0; } .ds-writing h3 { font-size:1.55rem; } }

components.name: Featured project
components.description: Tonal project link with metadata beneath its name. The site also includes the real Bolo icon.
components.html:
Bolo

Voice dictation · macOS

Hold a key to dictate into any app.
components.css: .ds-featured { display:block; padding:2.2rem 2.5rem; background:var(--surface); border-radius:3px; color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; } .ds-featured h3 { font:400 3rem/1.15 var(--font-display); letter-spacing:-.035em; margin:0 0 .3rem; } .ds-featured span { display:block; margin-bottom:.85rem; font:.65rem/1.5 var(--font-mono); color:var(--text-secondary); } .ds-featured p { font:1.05rem/1.6 var(--font-sans); margin:0; } .ds-featured:hover h3 { color:var(--accent); } .ds-featured:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Disclosure
components.css: .ds-disclosure { font-family:var(--font-sans); } .ds-disclosure summary { cursor:pointer; list-style:none; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.65rem; min-height:44px; color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:.8rem; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-disclosure summary::before { content:"+"; font:1.05rem/1 var(--font-mono); color:var(--accent); } .ds-disclosure[open] summary::before { content:"−"; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { color:var(--text); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-disclosure a { display:inline-block; padding:.5rem 0 .75rem 1.3rem; font-size:.85rem; color:var(--text); } .ds-disclosure a:hover { color:var(--accent); } .ds-disclosure a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The site pairs editorial headings with plain body text and small monospace metadata. Warm paper, dark ink, thin dividers, and restrained rust links keep writing and personal work readable. The supplied portrait and interactive bookshelf provide the personal character.
keyCharacteristics: Serif headings, sans serif reading text, and monospace dates.
A centered content column with open rows and one quiet featured surface.
Paired light and dark themes with the same hierarchy.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Use the existing semantic CSS properties so every surface follows the active theme.

rules.name: The Metadata Rule
rules.body: Metadata supports its heading. In the featured Bolo block, it follows the project name.

dos: Do use semantic theme properties for backgrounds, text, borders, and accents.
Do preserve the serif, sans serif, and metadata role separation.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and meaningful control labels.
Do keep the supplied portrait, actual app icon, and HTML book list available.
donts: Don't place project metadata above the featured project heading.
Don't replace real personal or project assets with invented product imagery.
Don't require portrait motion to access any content.
